how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and Small Block ticket go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives a Small Block prize ticket for the current block, and more referrals provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block provides the sole recurring $500 prize mechanism, with $5 from each $15 primary mint allocated to its prize pool and winners selected through Chainlink VRF.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click.

value_updates.buyer_earnings_explanation: Explain the $5 referral commission and Small Block prize tickets while stating that any future BooksOnChain governance-token allocation depends on FAMM succeeding and has no guarantee of success or value.
value_updates.referral_explanation: Explain that a mint number is the permanent referral code, successful referrals award $5 plus a Small Block ticket, and a no-code mint sends the commission and Small Block ticket to a random existing NFT holder.
value_updates.prize_explanation: Explain Small Block as the sole recurring $500 prize mechanism, with $5 from each $15 primary mint allocated to its pool and existing secondary-sale pool funding continuing to apply.
value_updates.ticket_explanation: Explain that referrals earn entries for the current Small Block draw, that more tickets increase the chance of winning, and that tickets expire after the Small Block draw.
value_updates.single_level_model_explanation: Explain that the model is single-level and source-verified on Basescan, that the founder receives $5 from each $15 primary mint and $4 from each secondary sale minus applicable fiat fees, and that each primary mint also allocates $5 to the affiliate and $5 to the Small Block prize pool.
